paper_title: Near-Quantum-Noise Axion Dark Matter Search at CAPP around 9.5 $μ$eV
notes: CAPP haloscope search over 9.39-9.51 ueV (2.2704-2.3000 GHz). Excludes coupling 2.7x above KSVZ level at 90% CL, assuming rho_a=0.45 GeV/cm^3. Exclusion limit shown in Fig.4 but no numerical table of g_agamma values provided. KSVZ at ~9.5 ueV corresponds to g_agamma ~ 1.1e-15 GeV^-1; 2.7x gives ~3e-15 GeV^-1 (approximate estimate).
